LESSON: CARE OF THE TEETH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.2: Care of the teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Care of the teeth
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Care of the teeth.

Try this

• Write 5 bullet facts about Care of the teeth.
• Say one safety rule.
